payload.core_composition_summary: Solution uses Union-Find to build connected components from given edges, then directly applies a closed-form greedy formula to compute minimum cost to connect components. No interplay of multiple non-trivial algorithmic mechanisms.
payload.rationale: The Disjoint Set Union (DSU) is the only non-trivial mechanism. The subsequent greedy step is a direct application of a known MST-like formula for star graphs, not a distinct algorithmic pattern worthy of separate composition. Therefore, it is effectively a single mechanism.
